issues.body: The manifest includes the literal `KNOWN_FAILING` in its introductory comments (including the claim that the marker is not written in this directory). `the_suite_declares_no_known_failing_case` recursively reads every file under `tests/trust-expression/` and flags any file whose text contains that exact substring, so it will always report `manifest.ttl` and fail whenever `framework-vocab` is enabled. This contradicts the feature-matrix claim that the companion guard runs successfully on the relevant legs.
issues.fix_hint: Remove the exact sentinel spelling from every file under `tests/trust-expression/` (rephrase the prose without assembling the token), or redesign the guard to parse an explicit machine-readable manifest property rather than substring-scanning comments. Keep a test proving an actual marked entry is rejected without making the checked-in suite self-trigger.
issues.title: Manifest contains the marker its fixture guard forbids

verdict.summary: The new fixture guard is guaranteed to fail: the suite manifest contains the exact marker that the guard recursively rejects. This prevents the advertised framework-vocab/cert-graph test legs from passing, so the change is not merge-ready.
